summary: Backend: 21/21 admin pytest tests PASSED against the public preview URL — admin login (wrong PIN→401, '123456'→200 with admin_token), X-Admin-Token guard on all /api/admin/*, stats shape (total_members, points_issued_today, visits_today, redemptions_today, week_earn_total, week_redeem_total, tiers{Silver,Gold,Platinum}, recent[]), members list with no _id leak, q=PG- search, GET member with transactions[], PATCH points_balance, PATCH tier override, PATCH suspended (suspended user verify-otp→403), credit-points happy path with by_admin=true txn and tier promotion at lifetime≥1000→Gold, credit-points unknown member 404, credit-points points<=0 400, verify-redemption first call sets used=true, second returns already_used=true, unknown code 404, admin/rewards lists inactive (whereas /api/rewards hides them), POST/PATCH/DELETE rewards (soft-delete) all work. FRONTEND BLOCKED: Critical infinite render loop ('Maximum update depth exceeded') on the /admin/login screen made it impossible to complete any frontend admin flow E2E. Root cause: (admin)/login.tsx lives INSIDE the (admin) group, but (admin)/_layout.tsx renders <Redirect href='/(admin)/login'/> when adminToken is null — the Redirect re-mounts the same layout which Redirects again → infinite loop and >300 console errors. Attempted a minimal fix using useSegments() to short-circuit the Redirect when already on login, but after restart the click on staff-sign-in still hung the page — the structural fix is to move login.tsx out of the (admin) group OR use <Slot/> with the redirect happening from the login route itself.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_update_member (lines 475-484): `get_old_balance` call after the update has already been persisted — `delta` will always be 0. The 'adjust' transaction also records `points=abs(int(payload.points_balance))` which is the NEW balance, not the delta. Logging is misleading but does not affect user-visible balance. Recommend computing delta BEFORE `db.users.update_one`.

rca_of_issue: Render loop RCA: In /app/frontend/app/(admin)/_layout.tsx, when `adminToken` is null the component returns `<Redirect href='/(admin)/login'/>`. Because login.tsx is itself a child of the (admin) group, expo-router re-mounts AdminLayout to render the login route. AdminLayout reads adminToken=null again → returns Redirect again → infinite re-render. Each iteration triggers a React setState (in Redirect's internal navigation hook), tripping the 'Maximum update depth exceeded' guard. Reproduction: load app → tap 'Staff sign in' on member login → observe 300+ identical console errors and an unresponsive page. Mitigation (preferred): move login.tsx out of the (admin) group so its rendering doesn't pass through AdminLayout. Mitigation (in-place): use `useSegments()` to detect the login route and render the Stack/Slot without redirecting — partial attempt applied to (admin)/_layout.tsx but did not fully break the loop in this preview; needs verification or replacement.
